drafted_from: tool:review-rows-of-a-list's own row (its words, input schema, sample runs and steps) and what its sample runs answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "Keep what a list of mine says true: set it up for review (an owner, a review state and a check-again date on each row, and views of what needs review), and mark rows verified, outdated or asking to be checked, or name their owner", with {"list_id":"docs","row_kind":"record:docs","action":"set_up","expires_days":30}. It runs tool:review-rows-of-a-list and answers {"list_id":"docs","set_up":true,"fields_added":["owner","review_state","review_due","verified_by"],"views_added":["review-needed","review-expired","review-empty"],"expires_days":30}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (list, [object Object]) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Keep what a list of mine says true: set it up for review (an owner, a review state and a check-again date on each row, and views of what needs review), and mark rows verified, outdated or asking to be checked, or name their owner", and give it list_id; row_kind (The record kind of the list's rows: record:<the list's row_type>); action.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:review-rows-of-a-list and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Give list_id (one of the person's lists), row_kind (record:<its row_type>, the records its rows are) and action.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: list (records:read, records:write); [object Object] (records:read, records:list, records:write).

worked_examples.title: Review the rows of a list on its own sample
worked_examples.ask: Keep what a list of mine says true: set it up for review (an owner, a review state and a check-again date on each row, and views of what needs review), and mark rows verified, outdated or asking to be checked, or name their owner
worked_examples.given: The input {"list_id":"docs","row_kind":"record:docs","action":"set_up","expires_days":30}, with 2 example rows (list, record:docs) already kept.
